title.zh: 文档配图来源与提示词

model_note.zh: 内置工具没有返回可核验的具体模型编号。
model_note.en: The built-in tool did not expose a verifiable model ID.

prompt_note.zh: prompt 字段保留实际发送的生成或编辑指令，属于原始技术记录。中文与英文图分别生成。
prompt_note.en: The prompt field preserves the actual generation or edit instruction as a raw technical record. Chinese and English illustrations were generated separately.

originals.zh: 生成的 PNG 原件保留在本机 Codex 输出目录；仓库内发布逐像素一致的无损 WebP。
originals.en: Original PNGs remain in the local Codex output directory. The repository publishes pixel-identical lossless WebP copies.

illustration_note.zh: 这些是概念图，不是实际应用截图。
illustration_note.en: These are conceptual illustrations, not screenshots of the application.

assets.prompt:
Use case: text-localization.
Make the English edition of this app-workflow concept illustration. Change only the printed text. Preserve the input paper and pencil, the three paper characters at a table, local record archive, open report and empty speech bubble, three right-facing arrows, object positions, warm ivory paper texture, purple/ochre palette, even bright lighting, and 3:2 landscape composition.

Remove all Chinese characters and use exactly:
Top heading: “From question to result”
Stage labels from left to right: “Input” “Simulation” “Storage” “Read and ask”

Use large bold dark graphite English lettering, readable at mobile width. Keep each label centered below its own station, with no overlap, cropping, or tiny text. Add no other words, version numbers, dates, technical system boxes, cloud icons, logos, or fake UI. No vignette or dark gradient.

Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create a finished Chinese conceptual illustration explaining a simple app workflow. 3:2 landscape, 1536 by 1024. Warm ivory textured paper, tactile layered paper sculpture, dark graphite bold typography, muted dusty purple and ochre accents, clean generous negative space. Background is uniformly bright ivory at every edge; no vignette or dark gradient. Soft tiny shadows only beneath objects.

Four large stations across the middle, connected by three clear right-pointing graphite arrows:
1) a paper input sheet with a pencil and a few abstract text lines;
2) three simple paper characters around a small round table, representing a simulation discussion;
3) a local archive box holding paper records, representing saving;
4) an open paper report with a simple empty speech bubble, representing reading and asking follow-up questions.
Keep it human-readable and conceptual. Do not draw microservices, servers, networks, clouds, provider logos, real UI controls, code, or a fake screenshot.

Only these exact Simplified Chinese words may appear:
Large heading at top: “从问题到结果”
Four stage labels in order: “输入” “推演” “保存” “阅读与追问”
All Chinese characters must be correct, large, bold, and readable at phone width. No English, numbers, dates, extra words, logos, or watermarks. Do not crop or overlap any label.

Use case: text-localization.
Make an English edition of this contribution-workflow illustration by replacing only its text. Preserve the four paper objects, their order and exact meaning (small edit, tests, review, local commit), the three right-facing graphite arrows, the uniform warm ivory background, muted purple and ochre, paper texture, soft object shadows, generous spacing, and 3:2 landscape composition.

Remove every Chinese character. Use exactly:
Heading: “Make a change, check it, then commit”
Four labels: “Change” “Test” “Review” “Commit”

The heading may wrap to two balanced lines in the existing top area to keep it large and readable. Use bold dark graphite lettering; do not crop or overlap text. No additional words, numbers, dates, logos, code, cloud or upload icon. Keep all four stage labels large. No vignette or dark gradient. This is an explanatory concept illustration, not a screenshot.

Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create one finished Chinese contribution-workflow illustration, 3:2 landscape, 1536 by 1024. Warm ivory paper-cut sculpture editorial style, dark graphite bold type, muted dusty purple and ochre accents. ENTIRE background must be uniformly bright ivory textured paper from edge to edge. No vignette, no dark gradient, no black overlay. Tiny soft shadows only directly under paper objects.

A simple four-stage left-to-right sequence, with three clear graphite right arrows and generous spacing:
1) a pencil making a small change on one paper sheet;
2) a paper checklist with a few large check marks representing tests;
3) a magnifying glass over the changed sheet representing review;
4) the checked sheet placed into a neat saved stack with a simple check-mark tab, representing a local commit.
Use tactile layered paper forms, not app screenshots or code interfaces. No cloud, no upload/publish symbolism, no decorative microtext, no invented code.

Only these exact Simplified Chinese words may be visible:
Large heading at top: “小步修改，验证后提交”
Labels beneath the four stages: “修改” “测试” “审查” “提交”
Use large, crisp dark graphite Chinese type, correctly spelled, with generous margins and no text collisions. Four labels must remain readable at mobile width. No English, no other text, numbers, dates, logos, or watermarks.

Use case: text-localization. Preserve this three-station warm ivory paper-cut illustration and replace EVERY Chinese phrase with English. Exact headline: “Three different kinds of record”. Exact column labels: “Proposal”, “Adoption”, “Execution record”. Exact captions respectively: “A character suggests an idea”, “Everyone agrees on the same plan”, “Check actions and results”. Exact bottom note: “All records describe the simulation”. Use large readable charcoal sans-serif English text; captions may wrap neatly into two lines within their column. Keep the three stations separate with no automatic arrows, leave execution checkboxes empty, preserve people, paper notes, notebook, palette and natural shadows. No Chinese characters remaining, no extra wording, no real-world guarantees or success badges, no watermark. Keep all labels and objects uncropped.

Use case: scientific-educational. Create a horizontal 3:2 beginner guide illustration in a warm ivory paper-cut editorial style: charcoal, muted amethyst and restrained ochre, soft natural shadows, clear large Simplified Chinese sans-serif text. Arrange THREE SEPARATE STATIONS with generous blank space, not an automatic arrow pipeline. Left: three paper speech bubbles with different small proposal notes near one person. Center: three distinct paper people openly agreeing around one selected note. Right: a clipboard beside a modest tabletop action scene, with empty checkboxes and an observation notebook, representing records that must be checked separately. Exact headline: “分清建议、采纳和执行”. Exact large column labels: “建议”, “采纳”, “执行记录”. Exact short captions under them respectively: “角色提出想法”, “各方明确同意同一方案”, “另看动作和结果”. Bottom note exactly: “以上都是模拟中的记录”. Do not imply that agreement automatically proves execution; no arrows between stations, no green success badges on execution, no real-world guarantee. All written text must be these Chinese phrases only. No English, logos, fake UI or watermark. Use the reference only for paper material, palette, and typographic legibility; do not copy its branching scenes.

Use case: text-localization. Edit the provided Chinese deployment-backup workflow into its ENGLISH-only companion. Preserve the 1536 x 1024 3:2 canvas, evenly lit warm ivory background, four paper-sculpture stations, exact positions and sequence, graphite arrows, pause/check/play symbols, paper textures, soft local shadows, and muted purple/ochre colors. Change only printed text; adjust title size and label line breaks minimally to fit. EXACT English text: main title 'Back up before upgrading'; stage labels left to right 'Stop services', 'Back up all data', 'Check the new environment', 'Start services'. The long third label may wrap onto two or three balanced lines INSIDE an expanded label card beneath the same third station; keep clear separation from its neighbors. Use large crisp heavy sans-serif graphite lettering. Remove every Chinese character, including title and stage labels. These five strings are the only text. Do not add numbers, subtitles, commands, logos, secrets, or new objects. Maintain the clearly separate NEW-environment validation tray and safe workflow order. No clipped letters, no dark vignette, no cropped stations.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE finished Chinese editorial workflow illustration for SwarmOracle deployment and backup documentation, NOT a UI screenshot. Canvas exactly 1536 x 1024, landscape 3:2. Warm ivory textured paper sculpture, graphite charcoal text and hand-drawn directional arrows, muted dusty purple and ochre accents, soft studio shadows, elegant minimal objects, generous negative space, clear large Chinese lettering. EXACT printed strings only: title '先备份，再升级'; four stage labels left to right '停止服务', '完整备份', '新环境验证', '恢复服务'. No other text, no numbers, no English, no secrets, no command snippets, no performance or prediction claims. Composition: title across upper area, then four evenly spaced simple paper-sculpture stations across the middle/lower area, linked left-to-right by three short clear arrows. Station one: a powered-down simple server stack with a small pause symbol. Station two: a protective backup archive box containing a database cylinder AND paper documents, showing complete saved state, not just one exported report. Station three: a separate fresh shallow paper tray with a new small server and a clear checkmark, indicating validation in a NEW environment before switching back on. Station four: a running paper server with subtle ochre indicator and a simple play symbol. The validation station must remain visually separate from the original stopped server; never show deleting original data or overwriting the backup. Put each exact stage label below its object, no overlap with arrows. Use at least 70 px margins; no clipped text or objects. Consistent premium handmade cut-paper editorial style, no fake dashboards, excessive decorations, glossy neon, or dense technical schematics.

Use case: text-localization. Edit the provided local-development illustration into an ENGLISH-only companion. Preserve the exact 1536 x 1024 3:2 canvas, local-machine tray boundary, every paper object, positions, arrows and their directions, ivory texture, shadows, muted purple and ochre palette. Change only printed text with minimal size adjustment so all English fits. The EXACT replacements are: main title 'Run locally'; browser label 'Browser'; frontend label 'Frontend'; backend label 'Backend'; database label 'Local data'; separate model-service pedestal label 'Model service'. Use large crisp dark heavy sans-serif English text. Remove every Chinese character. These six strings are the only printed text. Keep browser, frontend, backend, and database inside the tray; preserve the separately connected model service outside the tray. Do not add labels, numbers, explanations, secrets, ports, code, logos, UI controls, or offline claims. No clipped text or objects.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE finished Chinese editorial diagram for SwarmOracle local-development documentation, not a UI screenshot. Canvas exactly 1536 x 1024, landscape 3:2. Warm ivory textured paper-sculpture aesthetic matching a premium cut-paper editorial series: simple dimensional paper objects, soft studio shadows, graphite charcoal text and drawn arrows, muted dusty purple and ochre accents. Very legible large Chinese typography. EXACT printed text only: main title '在本机运行'; component labels '浏览器', '前端', '后端', '本地数据', '模型服务'. No other printed text, numbers, English, logos, ports, secrets, or code. Layout: main title top with generous margins. A broad shallow ivory paper tray encloses the local computer components in the left two-thirds: browser symbol at left, frontend paper panel at center, backend small paper server at right. Label each below. Simple arrows show Browser to Frontend to Backend horizontally. Under Backend, show a paper database cylinder labelled 本地数据 connected directly to Backend. On a separate small pedestal OUTSIDE the tray at the far right, show a muted purple paper cloud/server symbol labelled 模型服务, with one separate connection from Backend across the tray boundary to it. The tray visually means browser, frontend, backend, and data run on the same local machine, whereas model service may be separately connected or reached over a network; do not imply everything is offline. Keep nodes and labels separate, arrows unambiguous and not crossing any labels. Use symbolic hardware only, no fake application screenshots or form fields. Content within 70 px margins, no cropped shapes or text, no embellishments that resemble extra nodes.

Use case: text-localization. Edit the provided model-connection illustration into its ENGLISH-only companion. Preserve the 1536 x 1024 canvas, 3:2 composition, all paper-sculpture objects, graphite arrows, warm ivory texture, muted purple and ochre colors, lighting, and three-alternative-source flow. Change ONLY printed text and minimally adjust typography sizes/line breaks inside existing areas to fit. Replace the title with exactly 'Connect a model before starting'. Replace the three source-card labels, top to bottom, with exactly 'Server default', 'Saved profile', 'This run’s connection'. The last label may wrap over two lines without changing words. These are the only four text strings; remove all Chinese completely. Set large clear heavy sans-serif English typography with generous spacing and no clipping. Do not add numbers, subtitles, technical labels, logos, keys, predictions, UI widgets, or new objects. Keep all original objects and arrow directions intact.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE finished editorial illustration for SwarmOracle documentation, not a UI screenshot. Canvas 1536 x 1024, landscape 3:2. Match a warm ivory textured paper-sculpture aesthetic: dimensional cut-paper objects with soft studio shadows, graphite charcoal text and hand-drawn charcoal arrows, muted dusty purple and ochre accents, generous quiet space. Large crisp Chinese typography with safe margins, legible at document size. The sources are alternatives, not three required steps. Composition: large single title across top; below, three vertically arranged paper source cards on the left flow by distinct arrows into one simple central connector device, which flows toward the small character-discussion scene on the right. Only four pieces of printed text, exactly: title '先连好模型，再开始推演'; source labels '服务器默认', '保存的配置', '本次连接'. Do not print any other labels, numbers, English, logo, watermark, secret, key, API, code, benchmark, or prediction promise. Connector and character scene stay unlabelled. Keep all characters correct, all labels distinct, ample spacing between arrows and words, and all content within a 70 px safe margin. Avoid decorative dashboards, fake form fields, gradients, glossy futuristic hardware, dense connectors, and mandatory sequential interpretation of the three alternatives.
